## Add neighbour variables
We calculate three variables describing deviation from the neighbourhood: 
- share_area_par_nbr
- area_foot_bldg_median_nbr
- share_floorspace_par_nbr

They compare each parcel’s characteristic to the median of its nearby parcels (within 5 meters) in the same building block, producing relative deviation measures for area, footprint, and floorspace.

We calculate one variable describing accessible plot density
- apd_400m
 
## Input data
- Pre-processed parcel dataset of 2013

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_input <- st_read("./data_prep_output/parcels_predictors_04.gpkg")
```

## Data processing

### Deviation from the neighbourhood
We only consider neighbors which are located in the same building block. 
- We consider only parcels with at least one building (n_bldg > 0).
- We splits the dataset into blocks (id_block).
- Neighborhood analysis within each block:
  * We find all parcels within 5 m of distance for each parcel.
  * We collect the neighboring parcels’ values for share_area_par, area_foot_bldg_median, share_floorspace_par.
  * We compute the median of each variable among neighbors.
- We calculate relative differences (% deviation) between a parcel’s own value and its neighbors’ median for each variable.
- We recombine the results – All blocks are merged back together.

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Define column names
id_block <- "id_block"
id_par_merge <- "id_par_merge"
var1 <- "share_area_foot_par"
var2 <- "area_foot_bldg_median"
var3 <- "share_floorspace_par"
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Calculate neighborhood variables
# Filter out unbuilt parcels
parcels_variables <- parcels_input %>% filter(n_bldg > 0)

# Split by block
parcels_split <- parcels_variables %>% group_split(!!sym(id_block))

# Calculations per block
parcels_with_stats <- map(parcels_split, function(group) {
  neighbor_indices <- st_is_within_distance(group, dist = 5)
  
  group <- group %>% mutate(
    neighbors_ids = map(neighbor_indices, ~ .data[[id_par_merge]][.x]),
    var1_neighbors = map(neighbor_indices, ~ .data[[var1]][.x]),
    var2_neighbors = map(neighbor_indices, ~ .data[[var2]][.x]),
    var3_neighbors = map(neighbor_indices, ~ .data[[var3]][.x]),
    
    var1_median = map_dbl(var1_neighbors, ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    var2_median = map_dbl(var2_neighbors, ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    var3_median = map_dbl(var3_neighbors, ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    share_area_par_nbr = 100 * (.data[[var1]] - var1_median) / var1_median,
    area_foot_bldg_median_nbr = 100 * (.data[[var2]] - var2_median) / var2_median,
    share_floorspace_par_nbr = 100 * (.data[[var3]] - var3_median) / var3_median
  )
  return(group)
})

# Recombine and filter variables
parcels_nbr <- bind_rows(parcels_with_stats) %>% 
  select(id_par_merge, share_area_par_nbr, area_foot_bldg_median_nbr, share_floorspace_par_nbr) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
```

### Accessible plot density (Tümtürk et al. 2025)
This variable is calculated as the number of parcels which can be reached within a 400 m buffer. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Filter out unbuilt parcels
centroid <- st_centroid(parcels_input) %>% 
  select(id_par_merge)

buffer_400 <- st_buffer(centroid, 400)

intersect_buffer <- st_join(buffer_400, parcels_input %>% transmute(id_par_merge_400m = id_par_merge))

access_plot_dens <- intersect_buffer %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(id_par_merge) %>% 
  summarise(apd_400m = n())
```

### Add further neighbourhood variables on block level

```{r further neighbourhood var, include=FALSE}
block_var_age <- parcels_input %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  filter(ave_age_par != 0) %>% 
  group_by(id_block) %>% 
  summarise(age_pop_mean_block = mean(ave_age_par, na.rm = TRUE)) 

block_var <- parcels_input %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(id_block) %>% 
  summarise(fa_13 = sum(fa_13), 
            area_par = sum(area_par), 
            bldg_age_median_block = median(bldg_age_median, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(share_floorspace_par_block = fa_13 / area_par) %>% 
  select(-fa_13, -area_par)
```

## Join back to original data

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_nbr_fin <- parcels_input %>% 
  left_join(parcels_nbr) %>% 
  left_join(access_plot_dens) %>% 
  left_join(block_var_age) %>%
  left_join(block_var) %>%
  mutate(age_pop_mean_block = if_else(is.na(age_pop_mean_block), 0, age_pop_mean_block))
```

## Output

```{r, include=FALSE}
st_write(parcels_nbr_fin, "./data_prep_output/parcels_predictors_05.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)
```
